summary: BBVA filed a routine Form 6-K disclosing a one-notch upgrade by Morningstar DBRS of its long-term senior issuer rating to AA (low) from A (high), with the outlook shifted to stable from positive. DBRS also upgraded senior debt, subordinated debt, long-term deposits and senior non-preferred debt by one notch, while confirming short-term issuer, short-term debt and short-term deposits at R-1 (middle) and critical obligations at AA / R-1 (high), all stable. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is involved; this is a credit-rating disclosure, not a special situation.
